description: Changes the name, description, colour or video of a branded page made with create_branded_link. Pass only the fields to change; the link itself (slug) stays the same, so posters and shared links keep working. Needs the private edit_link (or slug and edit_key). Pass video_url as an empty string to remove the video. Logo and background are changed on the edit page, not here.

edit_key.description: The key after #k= in the edit link.

edit_link.description: The private edit link returned by create_branded_link (…/r/<slug>/edit#k=<key>). Alternatively pass slug and edit_key.

slug.description: The page's slug (the part after /r/). Needed with edit_key when edit_link is not given.

tagline.description: New one-line description; empty string removes it.

video_url.description: New video, or empty string for none. A direct video link (mp4, webm, m3u8) or a public YouTube video URL. Paid streaming services are not supported.

name: update_branded_link

code.description: Error code when ok is false.

ok.description: false when the call failed; then code says why.

title: Change a branded link
